用户目标：减脂
经验水平：新手
训练地点：居家
每周天数：3

请为以上用户搜索合适的训练动作，每个动作必须从 wger 数据库获取真实数据。一天训练安排 4-6 个动作。3 天需要覆盖不同的肌群组合。

args.summary: 为新手减脂、居家训练用户设计3天训练计划

todos.content: 搜索适合居家减脂的训练动作（自重、哑铃）
设计第1天训练计划（全身/上肢为主）
设计第2天训练计划（下肢+核心）
设计第3天训练计划（全身综合+有氧）

    With your feet raised approximately 30cm on a platform, align your shoulders, elbows and hands, then perform regular pushups. This emphasises the clavicular fibers of the pectoralis major.

    "}, {"wger_id": 57, "id": 57, "name": "Bear Walk 2", "target_muscle": "Shoulders", "image_url": "", "description": "

    -Rest your weight on your palms and the balls of your feet, not dissimilar to normal pushup position

{"total": 198, "count": 5, "exercises": [{"wger_id": 1963, "id": 1963, "name": "Slow Squat", "target_muscle": "Quads", "image_url": "https://wger.de/media/exercise-images/1963/db285682-1ab3-4be0-ae00-5117ecce1ee6.png", "description": "

  4. Form: Keep your chest up and weight in your heels.
"}, {"wger_id": 1965, "id": 1965, "name": "Marching High Knees", "target_muscle": "Quads", "image_url": "https://wger.de/media/exercise-images/1965/03c08a42-dedb-4a46-8d15-acaf497a35a2.png", "description": "

A low-impact cardio and mobility exercise that strengthens the hip flexors and improves balance.

  1. ​Movement: Stand tall and lift one knee toward your chest as high as comfortable.
  2. ​Arms: Swing the opposite arm forward as you lift your knee, similar to a walking motion.
  3. ​Core: Keep your abs engaged to maintain an upright posture.
  4. ​Pace: Perform the movement with control, alternating legs rhythmically.
"}, {"wger_id": 981, "id": 981, "name": "Step-ups", "target_muscle": "", "image_url": "https://wger.de/media/exercise-images/981/f9377a7e-eb58-4cca-b805-2d36863aeb03.png", "description": "

"}, {"wger_id": 2447, "id": 2447, "name": "Hip Airplane", "target_muscle": "Glutes", "image_url": "", "description": "

Stand on one leg and lean your upper body slightly forward while keeping your back straight. Extend the free leg behind you so that your torso and leg form roughly one line. Slowly open your hip to the side by rotating your pelvis and upper body in a controlled way. Then close the hip again and return to the starting position.

The movement should mainly come from the hip. Keep your standing foot stable and avoid letting your knee collapse inward.
